title: Fully Discrete Active Flux Method based on Transported Acoustic Increments for the Compressible Euler Equations
summary: A fully discrete Active Flux method is proposed for the two-dimensional compressible Euler equations. The method builds on the evolution-operator formulation of multidimensional Active Flux proposed by Roe in which conservative cell averages are updated by unsplit flux quadrature while primitive point values are evolved by acoustic and advective subsolvers. This has recently been extended to the Euler equations by Barsukow, who developed an efficient approach by adding acoustic increments at the Eulerian target point.
